seeded_mutations.note: The gate also caught a real defect in its own first version: the hand-transcribed prose expectation 'Reprinted with the permission from Ref. 1' did not match the source bytes, because the source has a non-breaking space (U+00A0) after 'Ref.' and the '1' is an <xref rid="bib1"> element, not a literal. The check was rewritten to assert the MARKUP fact (the caption's Ref. is followed by an xref pointing at bib1), which is strictly stronger than the prose match it replaced: it ties the reprinted figure to reference 1 mechanically.
